AcquisitionAuth.description:
Declares one request header whose value is read from an environment variable.

The job names the variable; the secret itself is never part of the policy.
AcquisitionAuth.title: AcquisitionAuth

AcquisitionPolicy.description: An exact host allowlist asserts the caller's permission to acquire a source.

browser.description: How browser sources load and observe a page: wait selector, resource and ad blocking, screenshot, and the operator-granted real Chrome, remote browser and persistent session.

hosts.description: Pacing and concurrency for one allowed host, overriding the job-wide min_interval_seconds and max_concurrency for it.
hosts.title: Hosts

http.description: HTTP transport settings: which browser to impersonate and which protocol version to ask for.

robots.description: "ignore" neither fetches nor enforces robots.txt for this job: the operator asserts permission. Jobs from agent tools, bundles, registry recipes and model output need the robots_ignore grant.
robots.title: Robots

rotate_egress.description: Egress profile names to rotate over, in order: each transfer of a source whose egress is "direct" uses the next one, and a proxy failure retries on the next.
rotate_egress.title: Rotate Egress

AcquisitionPolicy.title: AcquisitionPolicy

AfterObservation.description: Datetimes of ``field`` must not lie before the observation time (minus tolerance).
AfterObservation.title: AfterObservation

null_values.description: Text placeholders rejected after stripping whitespace and case folding.
null_values.title: Null Values

BrowserControls.description: How a browser source loads and observes its page.

block_ads.description: Refuse requests to a built-in list of ad-serving domains.
block_ads.title: Block Ads

blocked_domains.description: Hosts (and their subdomains) the page may not request.
blocked_domains.title: Blocked Domains

capture_network.description: Path regular expressions; matching responses are captured.
capture_network.title: Capture Network

cdp_url_env.description: Environment variable holding a remote browser DevTools URL; grant-only.
cdp_url_env.title: Cdp Url Env

disable_resources.description: Skip images, media and fonts; false loads them.
disable_resources.title: Disable Resources

network_idle.description: Also wait for network quiet when a wait_selector is set.
network_idle.title: Network Idle

pierce_shadow.description: Let selectors reach into closed shadow roots (stealth only).
pierce_shadow.title: Pierce Shadow

real_chrome.description: Drive the installed Chrome instead of bundled Chromium; grant-only.
real_chrome.title: Real Chrome

screenshot.description: Keep one PNG of the rendered page as evidence; needs the screenshots grant.
screenshot.title: Screenshot

session_profile.description: Name of a persistent browser profile under RASTRO_PROFILE_DIR; grant-only.
session_profile.title: Session Profile

wait_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before the page is read, instead of network quiet.
wait_selector.title: Wait Selector

wait_state.description: State the wait_selector element must reach.

BrowserControls.title: BrowserControls

ClickStep.description: Click the first element matching ``selector``, then optionally wait for ``wait_for``.
ClickStep.title: ClickStep

CommandProvider.description:
A local model command run without a shell; the prompt goes to stdin.

The command may forward page content to a hosted service, so it needs either
``allow_remote = true`` or ``local = true``. ``env`` lists extra variable names
passed through besides ``PATH`` and ``HOME``. Arguments may be empty strings; the
program (the first item) may not.
CommandProvider.title: CommandProvider

CssRecipe.description: Records at ``record_selector``; fields end in ::text or ::attr(name); steps run first.

steps.description: Browser actions (click, type, select, scroll, wait, follow) run before extraction; data only, never code.

CssRecipe.title: CssRecipe

DatasetSpec.description: Where approved records of a job would be stored and which fields identify a record.
DatasetSpec.title: DatasetSpec

DistinctRatio.description: Distinct values of ``field`` over record count must not fall below ``min_ratio``.
DistinctRatio.title: DistinctRatio

EgressProfile.description: One administrator-declared HTTP(S) proxy. Credentials are environment references.
EgressProfile.title: EgressProfile

EmbeddedJsonRecipe.description:
Read JSON embedded in HTML: ``source`` selects one node, then ``record_path`` and fields
work as in ``JsonRecipe``.

``source`` is a CSS selector ending in ``::attr(name)`` (``input[name=GXState]::attr(value)``)
or ``::text`` (``script#__NEXT_DATA__::text``); it must match exactly one node.
EmbeddedJsonRecipe.title: EmbeddedJsonRecipe

FileJobSource.description: Local HTML or JSON file source resolved within the job file's directory by default.
FileJobSource.title: FileJobSource

FollowStep.description: Open the link read by ``selector``, which must end with ``::attr(href)``.
FollowStep.title: FollowStep

HistoricalShift.description:
Median of ``field`` must not shift more than ``max_shift`` versus dataset history.

``unit = "days"`` compares datetimes; ``unit = "ratio"`` compares numbers as
``|current - history| / |history|``.
HistoricalShift.title: HistoricalShift

HostLimits.description: Politeness for one host: spacing, concurrency and adaptive throttling.

autothrottle.description: Widen the spacing when the host slows down or answers 429.
autothrottle.title: Autothrottle

max_concurrency.description: Transfers in flight to this host at once; unset keeps the job-wide value.
max_concurrency.title: Max Concurrency

min_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between requests to this host; unset keeps the job-wide value.
min_interval_seconds.title: Min Interval Seconds

HostLimits.title: HostLimits

JsonLdRecipe.description:
Map JSON-LD objects, optionally of one or several ``item_type`` values, with pointers.

``item_type`` is one type or 1..8 types; an object matches when any of its ``@type``
values is listed. A field maps to one pointer or to 1..4 pointers; the first that
resolves wins.
JsonLdRecipe.title: JsonLdRecipe

ScheduleSpec.title: ScheduleSpec

ScrollSpec.description:
Scroll a rendered page until a step finds no new records, or a cap is reached.

Scroll applies to ``render = "browser"``. It never enables stealth or challenge solving.
HTTP sources ignore it and say so (``scroll_ignored_http``); so do stealth sources
(``scroll_unsupported_stealth``): Scrapling keeps the page pooled, but Rastro does not
drive scroll in it. Both stay successful runs.
ScrollSpec.title: ScrollSpec

ScrollStep.description: Scroll to the bottom ``times`` times, waiting ``settle_ms`` after each.
ScrollStep.title: ScrollStep

SelectStep.title: SelectStep

SpiderPolicy.description: The job's ``[spider]`` table. ``mode = "list"`` (the default) is today's behaviour.

deny_pattern.description: Reject matching decoded paths before the page cap (linear-time regex).
deny_pattern.title: Deny Pattern

links.description: One CSS attribute expression or a list (up to eight); no comma groups.
links.title: Links

max_pages.description: Most pages fetched per start URL (1-100), or "unbounded" to crawl until the time budget runs out and resume from a checkpoint on the next run.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

time_budget_seconds.description: Seconds a crawl may run per start URL; an unbounded crawl saves its checkpoint when the budget runs out.
time_budget_seconds.title: Time Budget Seconds

SpiderPolicy.title: SpiderPolicy
